items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: No, I don't believe I met her. I don't believe I ever met her. I can't remember meeting her. ... I can't even tell you that, but I seen his mother in life. I might have though. I might have went to his mother, but I can't remember.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Oh boy, that was a stiff teacher. That's what I heard, yeah. He was stiff. He was stiff. Yeah, you had to learn there. Yeah. You had to learn. Never wanted to go to school there.

Did you ever meet George's mother? George's mother? No, I don't believe I met George's mother. I don't believe I ever met her. I can't remember meeting her. She's an older lady. She's, she died only a few years ago. She was about nearly a hundred, I think she's.

Yeah. I might have been George with the rifle. We supposed to get it plenty, you know. And George, I can't remember, I can't even tell you that, but I seen his mother in life. I might have though. I might have went to his mother, but I can't remember. You see. But I know his wife good, see. I used to be there all the time. I used to go on Rapport Street to get that red bean and them ham skin. He used to love red beans. And I'd come back and cook red beans and grab that horn. Soon he'd get through. Yeah, I bet he…

items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: I know his wife good, see. I used to be there all the time... I seen his mother in life.

ctx.x: I don't understand. What was he... Was he any good?

Oh, he had a cland in style, but I didn't like it. I didn't like his style. He had some kind of variation he made there. But it looked like to me, it was a little cland off, you know. He didn't have the real homie, you know. See, like George, like George said, but he stood right in homie, right in the key, you know. But all that stuff he made, he stood right there in the key. But once he looked like he was kind of... I never did like it. I used to come up with all the time. I said, okay. I tried to get a real…
Did you ever hear Johnny Dodds play?
